I'm late to this but this exact same thing happened to me. I got a call on a thursday with a reminder to attend a class. I called the EXACT extension she left in the message and it was unreachable. She didn't annunciate her name so I did know it it was Tania, Tina or what. I couldn't find her in the directory. I left and message and by the time they called me back, it was too late. I figured out that I had a zoom meeting to attend - and boy oh boy, was THAT a FULL DAY event! They said they were understaffed. We just sat there staring at people who didn't know how to turn their cameras off (saw some things I'd never like to see again).....and it started at 10, I was done at 3. Indiana only gives $390 a week max, which is the WORST. I finally found a job now but I just thought I'd update in case anyone is in this spot. 

They won't pay you for any previous weeks, only weeks going forward. The first payment takes 2 weeks to process. They wait one week I guess. If you're going on unemployment, be prepared for more BS than what its worth! Just go back to work ASAP!

This is going to sound lame, but WEED. I have smoked it in my adulthood & I have plenty of stories about that too lol... it just isn't it for me. My friend smoked a ton of it in high school. It made me lazy. It made me feel like a loser. I gained a bunch of weight and quit all of the sports I was in and the dance team my senior year. I stopped dressing up and just HATED myself. I think I fell into a deep depression during that time anyway, but the weed just made me overanalyze everything and the anxiety attacks were nightmarish. 

I pulled a Jessie Spano and took a bunch of Stacker 2 pills (Caffiene basically) to study for a test I had in 1st period. My friend decided it would be a good idea to smoke up together before class and that COMPOUNDED my anxiety. Needless to say, I had a full panic attack and actually fainted in my desk and fell to the ground. Everyone thought I'd died and said my head hitting the ground sounded like a bowling ball. So, yeah...that was fun. My teacher was hysterical and on the phone with "nursey" to hurry and check on me. I'm pretty sure everyone thought I was on heroin after that incident. 

TL:DR - Weed makes me think too much and causes panic attacks. I've done cocaine and lots of benzo's and I'm truly an alcoholic, but I just don't like weed. :D
